messages.observation-reading-only: Reading only: nothing here can change a game, a save or a repository.
messages.games-empty: No games yet. Choosing them comes in the next step.
messages.home-body: This window is the frame. Next it will show when you last worked on each game and what you did.
messages.tools-source: Read from the tool kit's own list of commands.
messages.tools-browser: This is the browser preview, so the tools can't be reached. The desktop program reads them.
messages.failure-python-missing-next: Install Python 3.10 or newer, or set PHOBOS_COMPANION_PYTHON to the one you use, then try again.
messages.failure-kit-missing: The tool kit is not where this program expects it.
messages.failure-kit-missing-next: Run git submodule update --init in this program's folder, or set PHOBOS_COMPANION_KIT, then try again.
messages.failure-tool-failed: The tool kit started but stopped with an error.
messages.failure-tool-failed-next: Open the technical details below, and run the same command in a console to see more.
messages.failure-unreadable: The tool kit answered in a way this program doesn't understand.
messages.failure-unreadable-next: This program and its tool kit may not match. Run git submodule update in this program's folder.
